notes.title: 1.01 Stability patch
notes.notes:
It turns out making a game is tricky! Who knew?!?! 

Huge thanks to all the early victims of the launch! We've been paying close attention to folks experiences and trying to make sure everyone has the best suicidal experience possible! Here's the immediate fixes addressed in this patch:
[list]
[*] Fixed memory leak issue that caused game to stop loading sprites after longer play times. 
[*] this fix should also address the inconsistent phoenix torch issue on World 1-5 "No Cave November" 
[*] slowed down lava speed on world 1 boss to be a little less punishing
[*] Made swinging chains in World 1 more visible
[*] Various sound balancing adjustments
[*] Music plays properly during credits
[*] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34336992/3aaeb80cdc5b8296f2b68bffebc06fb0069b53d2.gif[/img]

Thank you all again for your continued support and patience! We are so grateful to each and every one of you for believing in us!!! 

Hugs and stay safe,

Nate and Josh Long Neck

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED!
notes.notes:
It's finally happening! REZ PLZ is going to be released into the wild! We are so excited/nervous about releasing our first game into the world 07/15!!! We really hope you all enjoy this weird little game of ours.

[previewyoutube=XOrMjLain_s;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll be live streaming playthroughs of the game throughout the day, so if you get a chance, please stop by and say hi! 
Thanks for all your support, and we can't wait to see what you all think of the game! 

Cheers and stay safe,

-Josh and Nate
